entities.name: Clemence Sophia Harned Lozier
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Clemence Sophia Lozier was an American physician who founded the New York Medical College and Hospital for Women. Dr. Lozier was also a noted feminist and activist, and served as president of the New York City Suffrage League and the National Women's Suffrage Association.
